title: Wire taskweave-mcp into agent configs and trigger incremental codesearch upsert on save

sections.what: Register taskweave-mcp cleanly in workspace agent configs (.kilo, .opencode, Antigravity) and optionally trigger single-file codesearch index updates when JSON tasks are created, edited, or moved.
sections.why: Right now agent MCP configs still lack taskweave-mcp, and new or edited tasks rely on lexical matching until a manual codesearch re-index runs.
sections.how: Provide config snippets or CLI setup helper for MCP registration, and add an optional codesearch single-file refresh hook in store/service after JSON writes.
sections.verify: Verify MCP server starts over stdio from agent config and new JSON tasks become immediately searchable in codesearch.db.

acceptance.text: Agent MCP configs invoke taskweave-mcp over stdio cleanly
Creating or updating a JSON task refreshes an existing .codesearch index automatically without slow full re-scans

evidence: Registered taskweave MCP server in .kilo/kilo.jsonc and .opencode/opencode.jsonc (Antigravity mcp_config.json already configured).
Added `taskweave mcp-config` CLI snippet generator and `upsert_task_in_codesearch` hook in store.py write_new_task/save_task.
